CacheControl.description: Response caching policy. Signed URL responses are expected to be no-store.

file.description: Maximum 25 MiB. Supported: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, text, Markdown, JPEG, and PNG.

notifyOwner.description: Email the campaign owner only after the complete kit succeeds.

detailsUrl.description: Site path of the page explaining this consent, e.g. /consents/ai-processing. Absent when there is none.

requiredAt.description: Places this consent must be given. Strategy runs refuse without it.

canResume.description: Reviewer responses resume automatically. No public resume endpoint exists.

totalUnits.description: Null until Backend can determine a stable total from the frozen run plan.

pollAfterMs.description: Use this Backend-derived delay. Typical values are 2000, 5000, and 15000 milliseconds.

id.description: Legal document version id; submit it as an accepted version at sign-up or checkout.

requiredAt.description: Flows that must collect an acceptance of this version. The server enforces the same list.

content.description: The published markdown, exactly the text contentHash pins.

acceptedLegalDocumentVersionIdsV2.description: Ids of the active legal document versions accepted at sign-up, from GET /api/v2/legal/documents/active. The account is created with these acceptances or not at all.

givenConsentTypesV2.description: The consents given at sign-up: every consent the catalogue (GET /api/v2/legal/public/consents/catalogue) requires at SIGNUP. The account is created with them or not at all.

targetMarkets.description: The markets a strategy can target, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (GB for the United Kingdom) with country names. step1.targetMarkets and step1.primaryMarket accept exactly these values.

bearer.description: Short-lived access token held in frontend memory.

refreshCookie.description: Host-only HttpOnly refresh cookie; SameSite=Lax; Path=/v1/auth.
refreshCookie.name: adcendy_refresh

x-adcendy-cookie-policy.csrf: Same-origin routing plus SameSite=Lax and strict Origin/Referer validation; no separate CSRF token.

x-adcendy-cookie-policy.rotation: Every refresh rotates within the existing session family

x-adcendy-pipeline-run-operational-polic.billingGuarantee: Database uniqueness plus deterministic queue job IDs prevent duplicate billable execution.
x-adcendy-pipeline-run-operational-polic.duplicateBehavior: Same key and request replays the stored response; changed payload returns 409; simultaneous duplicate returns the completed response or RUN_EXECUTION_IN_PROGRESS.
x-adcendy-pipeline-run-operational-polic.polling: Use pollAfterMs: 2000ms initially, 5000ms after 30 seconds, and 15000ms while blocked. Status reads are limited to 30/minute and return Retry-After on 429.
x-adcendy-pipeline-run-operational-polic.runRetention: Runs are retained as durable campaign history; no public deletion endpoint exists.
x-adcendy-pipeline-run-operational-polic.unknownDeletedForbidden: Unknown runs return RUN_NOT_FOUND. Client cross-owner reads are intentionally concealed as RUN_NOT_FOUND; reviewer assignment violations return RUN_ACCESS_DENIED.

x-adcendy-pipeline-run-transitions.resumeBehavior: A valid reviewer response automatically resumes the same runId.

x-adcendy-pipeline-run-transitions.retryBehavior: Retry preserves runId and frozen config, increments attemptNumber, and resumes from the Backend-selected failed phase.

x-adcendy-proxy-policy.forwardedHeaderSanitization: The reverse proxy strips client Forwarded/X-Forwarded-* values and regenerates authoritative metadata.
x-adcendy-proxy-policy.forwardedHeaderTrust: Exactly one reviewed reverse-proxy hop; direct Internet access to Backend is prohibited.
